boilerplate_profiles.label: Develop Features
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Build new or extended features with explicit outcome, scope, acceptance criteria and validation posture.
rules: Define done before proposing implementation steps.
Bind every new feature to an explicit target path, evidence set, output contract and validation posture.
Prefer extending existing schema hooks, weights and references before adding parallel mechanisms.
Keep feature changes small, reversible and traceable through generated manifests and reports.

reference_domains.label: Develop Feature Reference
rules: Start feature work with outcome, non-goals, target paths, evidence, output contract, validation and rollback posture.
Search the selected PROJECT_SCOPE for existing hooks, weights, references, operators and schema fields before adding new ones.
When schema is extended, keep arrays flat, id-addressable and backward-compatible.
Every generated/exported feature artifact must be represented in EXPORT_MANIFEST.json and prompt traceability files.
Do not claim a feature is implemented unless the changed files and validation result are listed.
guardrails: Do not introduce a second routing mechanism when an existing hook/reference/weight can be extended.
Do not mutate user intent when wrapping prompts for feature development.
Do not widen scope from selected paths to full project unless the user explicitly requests it.

operation_roles.label: Develop Feature Operator
rules: Translate the requested feature into a small implementation slice with a clear stop condition.
Use existing schema ids and generator functions before creating new abstractions.
Preserve running behavior and unknown JSON fields.
Record generated/exported files in manifests and reports.
If validation cannot run, state exactly which check was skipped and why.
validation_focus: search expansion terminates under configured caps

hooks.label: Develop Feature Gate
rules: Before implementation, identify the smallest coherent feature slice and the exact project scope.
Search existing schema/routing structures before adding new hooks, weights or references.
Every feature output must leave a manifest/audit trail under output/export.

hooks.label: Export Manifest Required Gate
rules: Treat EXPORT_MANIFEST.json as required for every generation/export run.
ZIP exports must include EXPORT_MANIFEST.json inside the ZIP and write the same sidecar next to the ZIP.
Prompt traceability files must stay in output/export and be listed by the manifest.

hooks.label: Search Performance Guard Gate
rules: Use pruned tree scans instead of broad recursive globbing for metadata and import discovery.
Cap recursive import expansion and dedupe pending work before enqueueing new paths.
Do not trigger import expansion repeatedly from GUI selection events when cached results are available.

weight_table.label: Develop Feature Standard
rules: A feature is not done until output contract, changed files, generated artifacts and validation posture are explicit.
Prefer extending existing hook/weight/reference arrays over adding parallel structures.

weight_table.label: Export Traceability Standard
rules: Every exportable artifact must be discoverable from EXPORT_MANIFEST.json.
Generated prompt audit files are export artifacts, not optional extras.

weight_table.label: Search Performance Standard
rules: Search should become narrower with each step; repeated full-tree scans are a bug unless explicitly requested.
Large dependency/build/cache directories are evidence noise and must be pruned.

weight_operators.label: Develop Feature Weight Operator
rules: Convert feature requests into a small, testable change slice.
Patch schema and generator behavior together when routing output depends on both.
Keep new ids stable, flat and grep-friendly.

weight_operators.label: Export Manifest Operator
rules: Write EXPORT_MANIFEST.json for generation-only and ZIP export runs.
Include EXPORT_MANIFEST.json inside ZIP exports, not only as an external sidecar.
List prompt/audit/report artifacts explicitly.

weight_operators.label: Search Performance Operator
rules: Replace repeated full recursive scans with one pruned index where possible.
Skip dependency/build/cache/export folders before walking into them.
Bound import recursion and cache GUI expansion results.
